unlisted_practices: Embedding scored benchmark questions within a larger public question set with withheld answers to reduce leaderboard gaming and training-data contamination
Using ontology-grounded synonym sets (MONDO, NCBI Gene, NCBI Taxonomy) for lexical and concept-level evaluation of open-ended answers
Open-ended free-text QA format instead of multiple choice to distinguish reasoning from answer elimination

screen.reason: Introduces and evaluates a biomedical multi-hop question answering benchmark (MedHopQA) for LLMs; does not test a specific clinical deployment practice or safeguard.
